browse_tag.description: The newest artwork filed under one DeviantArt tag, such as 'digitalart' or 'watercolor'. Tags are single lower-case words - a '#' or capitals are trimmed off, and a phrase is refused with a pointer at 'Suggest tags' rather than returning nothing. Also reports DeviantArt's estimate of how many deviations carry the tag.

deviations.excerpt_text: A study of late afternoon light through birch trees.
deviations.title: Autumn Light

browse_tag.name: browse_tag

parameters.description: One DeviantArt tag: a single word of lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Use 'Suggest tags' to find the real tag behind a phrase.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: How many deviations to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Where in the results to start, for reading past the first page. Pass the previous step's 'next_offset' to continue where it stopped. Defaults to 0, the beginning.
parameters.name: offset

count.description: How many deviations are on this page.

estimated_total.description: DeviantArt's estimate of how many deviations carry the tag, or null when it does not offer one.

has_more.description: Whether DeviantArt has further results after this page.

next_offset.description: The offset to pass to the next call to read the following page, or null at the end of the results.

tag.description: The normalised tag that was browsed.

browse_topic.description: The artwork DeviantArt is currently showing under one topic, such as Digital Art or Photography. The topic is chosen from a dropdown filled with DeviantArt's own topic list, so it is always a name the API accepts.

deviations.excerpt_text: A study of late afternoon light through birch trees.
deviations.title: Autumn Light

browse_topic.name: browse_topic

parameters.description: Which topic to browse. The list comes from DeviantArt and refreshes with the field's refresh button.
parameters.name: topic

parameters.description: How many deviations to return, from 1 to 24. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Where in the results to start, for reading past the first page. Pass the previous step's 'next_offset' to continue where it stopped. Defaults to 0, the beginning.
parameters.name: offset

count.description: How many deviations are on this page.

has_more.description: Whether DeviantArt has further results after this page.

next_offset.description: The offset to pass to the next call to read the following page, or null at the end of the results.

get_deviation.description: One deviation in full by its id: title, artist, category, publication date, fave and comment counts, whether it is downloadable, its page on DeviantArt, and the image at every size DeviantArt renders it. Use 'Get deviation details' as well for its description, tags and view counts.

deviation.excerpt_text: A study of late afternoon light through birch trees.
deviation.title: Autumn Light

get_deviation.name: get_deviation

parameters.description: The deviation's UUID, returned as 'deviationid' on every deviation the search, tag, topic, gallery and Daily Deviation steps produce. This is not the number at the end of a deviation's web address.
parameters.name: deviation_id

deviation_id.description: The id that was looked up.

get_deviation_details.description: The description, tags and licence for one or many deviations at once - the fields a deviation record itself doesn't carry. Tick the extras for view and download counts, the submission details (category, file size, resolution), and the camera's EXIF data on photographs. Pass a list from any earlier step: it is split into the batch sizes DeviantArt allows and stitched back together, and any id that returned nothing is named rather than silently dropped.

metadata.description_text: A study of late afternoon light.
metadata.title: Autumn Light

get_deviation_details.name: get_deviation_details

parameters.description: One or more deviation UUIDs. Chain the 'deviationid' values from a search, tag, topic, gallery or Daily Deviation step, or paste a comma-separated list.
parameters.name: deviation_ids

parameters.description: Adds each deviation's views, favourites, comments and downloads. Asking for any extra lowers DeviantArt's batch size from 50 deviations per request to 10, so a long list costs more requests.
parameters.name: include_stats

parameters.description: Adds when each deviation was created, its DeviantArt category, file size, resolution and the app it was submitted with.
parameters.name: include_submission

parameters.description: Adds the camera data embedded in a photograph - make, model, exposure, aperture, ISO. Empty for artwork that was not photographed.
parameters.name: include_camera

batches.description: How many requests the list was split into.

metadata.description: One record per deviation DeviantArt could serve.

missing_deviation_ids.description: The ids DeviantArt returned nothing for - deleted, hidden, or mistyped.

requested_count.description: How many ids were asked for.

get_user_profile.description: One deviant's public profile: real name, tagline, country, website, biography (as HTML and as plain text), their latest status, and the counts behind their account - deviations, favourites, comments, page views and watchers. Tick the extras to list their gallery and collection folders too.
get_user_profile.name: get_user_profile

parameters.description: The artist's DeviantArt username - the name in their profile address, e.g. 'artist' in https://www.deviantart.com/artist. A full profile URL or an @name is accepted and trimmed down to the username.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: Adds the names and ids of the artist's gallery folders.
parameters.name: include_galleries

parameters.description: Adds the names and ids of the artist's public favourites folders.
parameters.name: include_collections

username.description: The username that was looked up.

list_daily_deviations.description: The Daily Deviations DeviantArt's staff featured on a given day - a hand-picked set rather than an algorithmic feed, which is what makes it worth a scheduled workflow. Each one carries the usual deviation fields plus the staff member who gave the award and the note they wrote with it. Leave the date empty for today.

daily_deviation.body: A quiet study that rewards a long look.

list_daily_deviations.name: list_daily_deviations

parameters.description: The day to read. Defaults to today. Days in the future are refused, and the archive this API serves starts at 2010-01-01.
parameters.name: deviation_date

count.description: How many deviations are on this page.

date.description: The day that was read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

has_more.description: Whether DeviantArt has further results after this page.

next_offset.description: The offset to pass to the next call to read the following page, or null at the end of the results.

list_gallery.description: Everything in one artist's public gallery, newest first - what a 'new work from the artists we follow' workflow is built on. Each deviation carries its title, image URL, publication date and fave count, plus the 'deviationid' the detail steps take.

parameters.description: How many deviations to return, from 1 to 24. Defaults to 24.

username.description: The artist whose gallery was read.

list_topics.description: The topics DeviantArt files artwork under - Digital Art, Photography, Anime, and so on - each with a few example deviations. The 'canonical_name' on each topic is what 'Browse a topic' takes; that step also offers them as a dropdown, so this action is for reading the list itself.

parameters.description: How many deviations to return, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Where in the results to start, for reading past the first page. Pass the previous step's 'next_offset' to continue where it stopped. Defaults to 0, the beginning.

count.description: How many topics are on this page.

next_offset.description: The offset to pass to the next call to read the following page, or null at the end of the results.

topics.description: The topics on this page, each with its display name, canonical name and example deviations.

search_deviations.description: Search DeviantArt for artwork by keyword - 'watercolour portrait', 'pixel art city'. Each result carries the deviation's title, artist, image URL, fave and comment counts, publication date and its page on DeviantArt, plus the 'deviationid' the other steps take. Leave the search empty to read DeviantArt's front page instead.

parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How many deviations to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Where in the results to start, for reading past the first page. Pass the previous step's 'next_offset' to continue where it stopped. Defaults to 0, the beginning.

count.description: How many deviations are on this page.

has_more.description: Whether DeviantArt has further results after this page.

next_offset.description: The offset to pass to the next call to read the following page, or null at the end of the results.

query.description: The words that were searched for.

suggest_tags.description: The real DeviantArt tags that start with a partial word - 'water' finds 'watercolor', 'watercolour', 'waterfall'. Worth running before 'Browse deviations by tag' on anything typed by a person or read from an earlier step: DeviantArt answers a tag that doesn't exist with an empty page rather than an error, so an unchecked guess looks like a subject nobody draws.
suggest_tags.name: suggest_tags

parameters.description: The beginning of a tag to complete. A leading '#' and capitals are trimmed off.
parameters.name: partial_tag

tags.description: The matching tag names, as DeviantArt spells them. Pass one to 'Browse deviations by tag'.

description: Search and follow art on DeviantArt: search the whole site or browse by tag or topic, read the staff's Daily Deviations for any day, follow an artist's gallery, and pull a deviation's full details - description, tags, licence, view counts and camera data - along with the artist's profile behind it.
